_about: Module definitions for the power group. See logistics.json for the shape. The Combustor burns a cell of fuel every `burn` seconds.

modules.name: Windmill
modules.blurb: Turns in open sky and feeds the Hub's stockpile while a Node or the Hub is within reach. Gusts come and go.

modules.name: Solar Panel
modules.blurb: Bolted in place. Needs a clear line up to the sky (a panel at the bottom of an open pit works) and feeds the Hub's store while a Node or the Hub is within reach. Steady, with no gusts; the biome under it sets how much, and Dunes pay best.

modules.name: Waterwheel
modules.blurb: Bolted in place. Water falling onto its top runs through it and out underneath, about 0.0125 power a cell up to 40 cells a second, into the Hub's store while a Node or the Hub is within reach. It needs no sky, so it earns at depth under a spring (the Fen's pockets have them); water pooled under it stalls it.

modules.name: Combustor
modules.blurb: Bolted in place. Fuel joined into its bottom face (Coal, Coal chunks, Slick, Pitch, Lift) is burnt a cell a second for 1 to 4 power each, added to the Hub's store while a Node or the Hub is in reach. It burns nothing while the store is full.

modules.name: Thermoelectric Plate
modules.blurb: Bolted in place. Turns a difference in temperature into power: every degree between the cells against its two long sides gives 0.001 power a second, up to 0.8, to the Hub's store while a Node or the Hub is in reach. It reads the world's cells, so it earns against hot ground or lava, not beside a vessel.
